name: Blue Swallowtail
desc: Blue Swallowtail (Battus philenor): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 21 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Battus philenor, the pipevine swallowtail or blue swallowtail, is a swallowtail butterfly found in North America and Central America. This butterfly is black with iridescent-blue hindwings.
